parsed.note_claim: Viral videos depicting Indian street food as unclean are AI-generated fakes spreading on social media.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Lead Stories has spotted a number of such clips recently and has found that many of them were created using artificial intelligence. The implied notion was that Indian food is being prepared and consumed in unsanitary conditions.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly confirms that viral clips showing Indian food prepared unsanitarily are created using artificial intelligence.
